policy: PERSISTENT signing identity for monotone release statements (v1.5.0, anp2network round 4, dev.to 3ehp6). The first key in this project that is neither a throwaway (ca-test-1 style: discarded after signing) nor published-with-its-private-half (ca-test-2 style: generator CA).
